verdict.rationale: Sentry documents its own agentic automation: Seer root-cause analysis can be handed to connected coding agents (Cursor Cloud Agents, GitHub Copilot) for automated fix generation and pull request creation. This is a narrow, issue-fix workflow, though, and the evidence does not show user-defined automations that trigger and run autonomously in the background. Cron Monitoring only watches the user's own scheduled jobs, and Alerts appears as a title only, so neither counts here. Missing for 10: general user-configurable automation rules or triggers, evidence that Seer or agent handoffs run unattended on schedules or events without manual launch, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Seer's root cause analysis can be sent directly to the agent for automated fix generation and pull request creation.
The Cursor Agent integration allows you to launch Cursor Cloud Agents directly from Seer to help debug, fix issues, and create pull requests for you.
Set up the GitHub Copilot integration to send Sentry issues directly to Copilot agents for automated root cause analysis and fix generation.
